title: Global Self-Improvement Candidate Identity + Namespace Gate

source_provenance.locator: 2026-08-21 directive: parallel GitHub/Drive analysis, concrete engineering, Self-Improvement, 32 sequential prompts -> 64 next

source_provenance.notes: Complete Registry Identity Law requires full-family visibility before allocation

problem_or_opportunity: Parallel candidate creation can allocate the same SI identity to different mechanisms because current family validation does not treat every candidate-bearing root as one namespace.
proposed_mechanism: Scan base registry + all extension shards + PENDING + configured roots; fingerprint candidate semantics; classify unique, same-mechanism duplicate, true ID collision, tracked migration debt and redirects; compute next-free ID only from complete visibility; require provenance-preserving migration and re-audit before promotion.
expected_benefit: Prevents semantic identity corruption, unsafe registry compaction, cross-dialog candidate overwrite and false lifecycle continuity.

development_contract.promotion_blocker: SI-0010 collision remains tracked until PR108/equivalent repair lands and full repository readback is clean

pilot_evidence: Real SI-0009 collision detected and migrated to SI-0015 with redirect
Real SI-0010 collision detected independently by this cycle and PR108; duplicate repair intentionally avoided
Negative fixtures cover collision, tracked debt, redirect, dangling redirect and unindexed extension
red_team_findings: Scanning only registry family is insufficient when PENDING can allocate global IDs
Tracked debt must not be interpreted as clean PASS
Semantic fingerprint is an identity aid, not proof that two subtly different candidates should merge
ID migration must not inflate candidate status/scope
next_action: Run real repository audit after current branch changes and again after PR108 merge/rebase; only clean global namespace can unlock promotion eligibility.
hold_trigger: Any newly discovered candidate-bearing root or collision not covered by the configured scan.
